decisions.decision: Wordmark is drawn geometry (rect + ellipse arcs + straight bands), not typeset Bodoni.
decisions.reason: Round 1 was rejected because the mark was a default font extruded. A constructed mark gives a checkable spec (grid, stroke weights, apertures, spacing) and survives every scale.

decisions.decision: Adopt cut A (Didone serif) as the primary mark, with cut C (material window) as the hero rendering; cut B (geometric sans) kept as an alternate.
decisions.reason: A carries the editorial/print register the four references share; C makes type and material one physical object instead of type on a colour block. B is more contemporary but loses the print register.

decisions.decision: Hero wordmark set at 101.9vw, cropped only through the outer serifs (13.7px per side, 1.9% of ink width); stems sit flush with the frame.
decisions.reason: A larger crop destroys the brand name (MORTON must read in 0.5s); a 1.2% crop left a paper sliver inside the M's stem. Flush stems + bleeding serifs keep the full word and still read as a deliberate print bleed.

decisions.decision: The last two letters are punched out of the lacquer plate (paper letters in a material field); base line runs through both grounds.
decisions.reason: Satisfies 'material and type must interlock, not stack'; the baseline joins the two halves and carries the overflow gesture.

decisions.decision: Opening cover re-uses the hero's exact geometry (plate rectangle, wordmark ink box, baseline) and renders it in three line weights with per-letter 62% plot progress.
decisions.reason: Phase 2 must open from the cover into this hero; identical geometry is the only way the reveal can be continuous. No numbers.

decisions.decision: About uses p01 paper as its main image (not p02 plaster as first suggested).
decisions.reason: p02's right-third shadow band would put the 112px title (which crosses the image edge) on a mid-dark field, breaking the crisp crossing. p01 keeps the crossing ink-on-light and is an approved plate.

decisions.decision: About title (112px) starts inside the image and crosses its right edge; the image gets a 1px edge at 30% ink.
decisions.reason: Text-over-image is one of the two allowed type/image relationships; the 1px edge makes the crossing crisp instead of 'half-covered'.

decisions.decision: Works is the only dark chapter (#181816); main exhibit 64.7vw bleeding left; three secondary plates at 4:5 / 4:5 / 3:2 with captions on one baseline; a 4-column catalogue strip.
decisions.reason: One dark gallery chapter creates the section contrast the brief asks for; unequal ratios and a dense index avoid the card-wall.

decisions.decision: Focus has a 112px title, a 2x2 meta table on 1px rules, a 33ch note, a 2:1 detail inset placed on the exhibit, and a 1px rectangular Back control (38px tall).
decisions.reason: Product-level information hierarchy with one real control; the detail belongs to the exhibit, not to another card in the column.

decisions.decision: Every mobile frame is re-composed (bands / stacks / different crop), never a scaled desktop.
decisions.reason: 390px cannot carry 112px three-line titles or a 52vw bleed; each mobile frame gets its own rhythm while keeping the same tokens.

decisions.decision: Secondary information is stepped down by size (11–12px) and the muted colour, never by opacity.
decisions.reason: Opacity turns small text into grey fog; the brief forbids it. Verified on all five frames.

decisions.decision: No fake percentages, awards, clients or links; all unverified content is a bracketed placeholder.
decisions.reason: Asset register requires real provenance; the brief forbids invented achievements.
